## Proposed contribution

State the change in one precise sentence.

## Mathematical status

- Proposed status:

## Argument or evidence

## Dependencies

## Result boundary

## AI-assistance disclosure

Name any system used materially and describe the human verification performed, or write “None.”

## Verification

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the relevant manuscript statement.
- [ ] I checked hypotheses, orientations, quantifiers, and normalizations.
- [ ] I updated affected status/evidence records or explained why none change.
- [ ] I separated computational evidence from proof.
- [ ] I did not promote a finite, one-scale, or conditional result to an unconditional proof of MLC.
